findings.description: The truthiness checks skip color index 0 for both foreground and background.
findings.rationale: Calling style("text", fg=0) or style("text", bg=0) now skips the corresponding ANSI sequence because 0 is falsy. Index 0 is a valid palette color, so text uses the terminal's existing color instead of the requested black.

findings.description: Removing component range validation allows invalid palette and RGB values to be emitted as ANSI color sequences.
findings.rationale: For example, style("text", fg=256) or style("text", fg=(256, 0, 0)) previously raised ValueError. The changed code emits out-of-range color sequences instead, so callers receive no validation error and terminal rendering can ignore or misinterpret the requested color.
